modules.module_title: Carry out supporting operations with in footwear

pcs.pc_description: follow the instructions on the work ticket/ job card
check that the work area is free from hazards and report risks/problems likely to affect services to the relevant person promptly and accurately
support the operator in checking the materials used meet the specification matching within a product between a pair of products where applicable
agree and review your agreed upon work targets with your supervisor
assist in carrying out foundation footwear operations safely and at a rate which maintains work flow and meets production targets
report any damaged work to the responsible person
ask questions to obtain more information on tasks when the instructions you have are unclear
anticipate and respond to requests for assistance from colleagues willingly and politely
update and develop knowledge of the products, check with others when unsure of new product details
sort and place work to assist the next stage of production and minimize the risk of damage
choose the tools and materials required for the lasting process and get the closed uppers from the closing section
check that the numbers of closed uppers are equal to that in the work ticket/job card.
place the closed uppers in the mulling chamber for vaporizing
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
collect the closed uppers from the mulling chamber and puts the insole onto the lasts
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
cleans the tools and keep the workplace tidy
choose the tools and materials required for the lasting process and get the closed uppers from the closing section
place the closed uppers onto the counter tightening machine for counter tightening
takes the closed uppers from the machine after counter tightening and place the uppers to toe molding machine
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
choose the tools and materials required for the lasting process and get the uppers from the upper making section
check that the numbers of closed uppers are equal to that in the work ticket/job card.
place the closed uppers on to the forepart/toe lasting machine
take the closed uppers from the forepart lasting machine and place them on to the side lasting machine
take the closed uppers from the side lasting machine and place them on to the seat lasting machine
mark the back height on the last by tack
check the amount of wrinkles or folds and see that the lasting is properly done
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
choose the tools and materials required for the heat setting process and get the lasted uppers from the lasting section
check that the numbers of lasted uppers are equal to that in the work ticket/job card.
keep the lasted footwear in the heat setting machine
take the footwear out of the machine after the heat setting
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
choose the tools and materials required for the roughening process and get the lasted uppers from the heat setting section
check that the numbers of lasted uppers are equal to that in the work ticket/job card.
flatten the bottom of the lasted uppers with pounding machine
assist the operator in roughening out the finishing/peripheral layer of the lasted uppers
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
cleans the tools and keep the workplace tidy
choose the tools and materials required for the buffing process and get the footwear from the roughened section
help in sorting the roughened uppers to ensure quality norms are adhered to
assist the buffing operator to buff the roughened upper to make it dust free
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean the tools and keep the workplace tidy
choose the tools and materials required for the bottom filling and get the footwear pieces from the buffing section
check that the numbers of buffed uppers are equal to that in the work ticket/ job card.
attach bottom fillers to the buffed uppers
check the quality and appearance of the product as per job card
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean the tools and keep the workplace tidy
choose the tools and materials required for adhesive adding and get the footwear pieces from the bottom filling section
apply two thin layers of adhesive on the lasted part of the uppers
apply one thin layer of adhesive on the sole
dry the adhesive in normal condition
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean the tools and keep the workplace tidy
choose the tools and materials required for the reactivation
place the lasted bottom and sole in the reactivation chamber/machine
take the lasted bottom and sole out of the chamber after the reactivation process
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
choose the tools and materials required for the sole pressing
put the sole on to the lasted uppers by hand
place the lasted footwear on the sole pressing machine
take the completed footwear out of the sole pressing machine
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
choose the tools and materials required for the sole pressing
place the lasted footwear for cooling in the machine
take the footwear out, after the cooling
place the footwear in the de-lasting machine
check the quality and appearance of the product as per job card
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
clean and oil the machinery and report any repairs, if required
insert the socks into the footwear
check the quality and appearance of the product as per job card
correctly sort and place the work to assist the next stage of production
check that the number of lasted uppers are equal to that in the work ticket/job card
clean the tools and keep the workplace tidy
